Yet Kyler Murray’s health is a question mark, your running backs are a triage unit and depth behind Jefferson is thin. Chudders Football Team.essay_snippet: The rebuild is in full swing. Jahmyr Gibbs and Ashton Jeanty give you perhaps the best young RB duo in the league, and Justin Herbert remains underrated in dynasty circles. Unfortunately the WR room is barren and your backup QBs read like waiver-wire fodder. With a league-high haul of first-round picks you’re clearly playing for 2026. Chudders Football Team.roast: Two firsts in two years and Gibbs. You’re that guy bench-pressing next to the trophy case.

Father Time.roast: Your WRs are wagyu beef; your RBs are ramen noodles.

A surprise early exit in 2024 barely dented your aura – your bench could compete in most leagues. The 2025 roster reads like the All-Pro team: Maye and Richardson headline a four-deep quarterback room with J.J. McCarthy and Trevor Lawrence backing them up. Your weekly projection around 46 points is tied for third-highest, though depth is still a concern – one injury and you’re starting Bryce Young. The schedule is slightly tougher than average. Kittler on the Roof.roast: Your floor is nice but your ceiling might be drywall.

Jalen Hurts is a cheat code, and Jordan Addison appears ready to claim a bigger role opposite Cooper Kupp and Keenan Allen.
